integrity: The proof is symbolic. A direct Reid--Tai replay independently checks classification and junior indices through r=30 and boundary formulas through r=300. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the two-heavy weighted-projective family. The theorem counts local age-one elements in the two heavy cyclic quotient charts; it does not identify global crepant valuations or assert existence of a crepant resolution.
title: Junior-element profile on the canonical non-terminal boundary of two-heavy weighted projective spaces
